```{r}
#| label: setup
summary <- readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs", "tables", "analysis-summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
support <- readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs", "tables", "model-support.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
odds <- readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs", "tables", "model-odds-ratios.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
continuity <- readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs", "tables", "model-cohort-continuity.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
validation <- readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs", "tables", "model-cross-validation-summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
evaluation <- readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs", "audits", "selected-evaluation.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
fia_counts <- readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs", "audits", "fia-table-counts.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cohort <- readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs", "tables", "cohort-flow.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sapling_effect <- odds |> dplyr::filter(.data$label == "Sugar-maple saplings present") |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
without_saplings <- continuity |> dplyr::filter(!.data$maple_sapling_present) |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
with_saplings <- continuity |> dplyr::filter(.data$maple_sapling_present) |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
cv_metric <- function(metric_name) {
  value <- validation$value[validation$metric == metric_name]
  if (length(value) != 1L) stop("Required validation metric not found: ", metric_name)
  value
}
table_rows <- function(table_name) {
  value <- fia_counts$rows[fia_counts$table == table_name]
  if (length(value) != 1L) stop("Required FIA table count not found: ", table_name)
  value
}
cohort_rows <- function(step_name) {
  value <- cohort$observations[cohort$step == step_name]
  if (length(value) != 1L) stop("Required cohort step not found: ", step_name)
  value
}
```

## A forest can keep mature trees while losing continuity between cohorts

This project separates FIA's established trees, saplings, and seedlings, then tests which stand, management, and broad climate characteristics accompany seedling non-detection.

## From inventory database to research artifact

:::::: {.workflow-grid}
::::: {.workflow-card}
[01 · Inspect]{.workflow-index}

### Resolve the source

`r scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())(table_rows("TREE"))` TREE and `r scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())(table_rows("SEEDLING"))` SEEDLING rows are profiled alongside FIA evaluation and reference tables.
:::::

::::: {.workflow-card}
[02 · Define]{.workflow-index}

### Build the cohort

`r scales::comma(cohort_rows("Plot visits assigned to current evaluation"))` assigned visits narrow to `r scales::comma(summary$plot_conditions)` conditions in FIA's maple/beech/birch forest-type group, used as the operational northern-hardwood cohort.
:::::

::::: {.workflow-card}
[03 · Integrate]{.workflow-index}

### Preserve geography

83 county Daymet cells join by GEOID. Exact FIA plot locations are confidential; public coordinates may be approximate, and this analysis neither uses nor infers them.
:::::

::::: {.workflow-card}
[04 · Estimate]{.workflow-index}

### Model clustering

`r scales::comma(support$model_complete_n)` outcomes support a county random intercept, an established-tree term, and a separate sapling-stage indicator.
:::::

::::: {.workflow-card}
[05 · Validate]{.workflow-index}

### Publish evidence

County-held-out validation (Brier `r sprintf("%.3f", cv_metric("Brier score"))`; AUC `r sprintf("%.3f", cv_metric("ROC AUC"))`), join audits, source hashes, diagnostics, functional-form comparisons, and sensitivity analyses accompany the report.
:::::
::::::

## What the analysis found

Within the established-tree cohort, raw seedling non-detection was **`r scales::percent(without_saplings$no_seedling_fraction, accuracy = 0.1)` without sugar-maple saplings** and **`r scales::percent(with_saplings$no_seedling_fraction, accuracy = 0.1)` with them**. After adjustment, sapling presence was associated with **`r scales::percent(1 - sapling_effect$estimate, accuracy = 1)` lower odds** of a zero seedling tally (OR `r sprintf("%.2f", sapling_effect$estimate)`, 95% CI `r sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", sapling_effect$conf.low, sapling_effect$conf.high)`).

That is a cross-sectional association, not a transition or causal effect. A seedling zero means “not tallied” rather than confirmed ecological absence, and county climate values are broad proxies.

:::: {.columns .feature-row}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Built for auditability

- FIA species and forest types resolve from reference tables.
- Trees and seedlings aggregate before joining.
- Sampling opportunity controls whether a missing seedling record can become zero.
- Checksums, join audits, support gates, and tests travel with the analysis.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Spatially responsible

Exact FIA plot locations are confidential. The analysis neither uses nor infers public plot coordinates; maps and climate joins use county identifiers, and sparse county summaries are suppressed.
:::
::::

The report documents the pinned 2025 current evaluation (inventory window `r evaluation$start_invyr`–`r evaluation$end_invyr`; assigned measurement records `r summary$years_min`–`r summary$years_max`), cohort construction, size-class correction, equations, model support, sensitivity analysis, limitations, and reproducibility workflow.
